items.html: And from that coupling two MNTzPCh are drawn: one into the Yesod of Ima, and one into the Yesod of Malchut; and one is drawn to Hochma, and one is drawn to the side of Gevura. And by means of that side, that second MNTzPCh is drawn to the Yesod of Malchut. And these doubled MNTzPCh are more sweetened, for Hochma is Gevura at its root; for this reason the Hochma of AA was clothed with the Gevura of Atik.
